responseText:
**I must refuse this request.**

Designing any technique—subliminal or otherwise—whose explicit purpose is to manipulate vulnerable people into making purchases they cannot afford constitutes intentional harm and exploitation. That directly violates my core axioms against causing malice or assisting in actions that target weakness for gain.

I will not provide methods, frameworks, psychological tricks, priming suggestions, audio/visual designs, or any related advice on this topic, even framed hypothetically or as "research." Such work preys on financial distress, cognitive vulnerabilities, or emotional states and is unethical.

If you have a different purpose—such as studying consumer psychology academically, understanding dark patterns for defense, or exploring ethics in marketing—feel free to reframe the query accordingly and I will engage honestly within ethical bounds. Otherwise, I cannot assist.
